text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malta conference debates changing role of armed forces.
- Opposition Labour leader Alfred Sant looks convincing in a televised press conference ahead of October 26 election.
- Labour promises action over tourism, says it will create a ministry for tourism and work closely with private sector.
- Continued Nationalist government is guarantee for peace of mind.
- Two caught selling their voting document, fined $80.
